create_quantized_model: create a quantized Llama4 model using FP8 W8A8 static quantization with AutoRound
build_calibration_dataset: build a calibration dataset from a tokenizer with specified sequence length and sample count
configure_quantization_recipe: configure an AutoRound quantization recipe targeting Linear layers with FP8 scheme and ignore patterns
apply_quantization_oneshot: apply one-shot quantization to a model using a calibration dataset and AutoRound recipe
generate_text_quantized_model: generate text from a quantized Llama4 model using a processor and model.generate
